description_en: Intelligently identifies and removes text, specific names, transparent text blocks, and watermarks from e-commerce images, supports specifying objects to remove as needed, enables efficient and precise batch processing of images, and simplifies image editing workflows (synchronous/asynchronous)
description_zh: 图像智能消除产品专为电商图片定制，自动识别并消除电商图片中的文字、特定名称、透明字块和牛皮癣，可按需指定消除图片内对象，实现大批量图片的高效、精确处理，简化图片编辑工作（同步/异步）
name: ImageRemovalPro
